source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U07: Distinguish sale from agreement to sell and separate ownership,risk and performance

payload.title: Ask when property passes,not merely when cash moves
payload.core_explanation_md:
A sale and an agreement to sell are distinguished by the passing of property in the goods. A future time or unfulfilled condition can keep a transaction at the agreement-to-sell stage. Payment,delivery and ownership may occur at different times,so a paid invoice alone does not settle the classification.

Risk and remedies also need the contract and applicable rules. The textbook comparison should not be copied as a universal statement that delivery,payment and risk always move together. For finance against goods,preserve identification,title conditions,payment evidence,delivery/control and any unpaid-seller rights as distinct checks.

self_check.prompt_text: Does paying the price necessarily prove every ownership condition was fulfilled?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The property-transfer terms and facts remain relevant.

payload.stem_md: Payment is made now,but the stipulated ownership-transfer condition remains unfulfilled. Which fact determines sale versus agreement to sell?

options.explanation_md: Payment alone may not pass property.
A preferred label does not establish ownership.
Appearance does not settle the legal event.

options.text_md: The actual passing of property under the applicable terms
options.explanation_md: The classification depends on that event.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The classification depends on that event.

payload.stem_md: A risk note assumes that physical delivery,ownership and payment always occur simultaneously. What must be checked?

options.text_md: Only whether the transaction is profitable
options.explanation_md: Profit does not determine these events.

options.text_md: The contract terms and applicable rules for each separate event
options.explanation_md: They can occur at different times.

options.text_md: A rule that risk never passes
options.explanation_md: That opposite blanket rule is also unsupported.
Software does not set legal ownership.

payload.correct_explanation_md: They can occur at different times.
